Outside risk外部风险 What could hit from abroad外部可能的冲击
Pressure coming from outside China — US interest rates, the yuan, the gap between US and Chinese yields, and how many stocks are joining in. It sets the backdrop for how big to trade. It never removes a name and never changes the board's order.来自中国以外的压力 — 美国利率、人民币汇率、中美利差，以及有多少个股在参与。它决定该用多大仓位，但绝不剔除任何标的，也不改变看板排序。

Theme cycles主题周期

?Each theme is a curated basket of A-shares with its own turn model, and the rail shows where that basket sits in its cycle. Every member is then placed in exactly one column, so a row adds up to the whole basket; a name counts once, at its most actionable state, and a name can sit in more than one theme. The cycle read is a place to look, not a measured edge — no horizon of it has cleared a significance bar. Nothing on this panel ranks, gates or sizes anything, and the board above is identical with it present or absent.每个主题都是一篮精选A股，各自带有转向模型，刻度条显示该篮子在周期中的位置。每只成分股被归入且仅归入一列，因此整行相加等于该篮子全部成分股；同一只股票按其最可操作的状态计入一次，且可能同时属于多个主题。周期研判只用于确定观察方向，并非经检验的优势——尚无周期通过显著性检验。本面板不参与任何排名、筛选或仓位决定，上方看板有无本面板都完全相同。 as of 2026-11-03截至 2026-11-03

Reversion Desk回归台 ?Stocks that fell the most within their own sector over the last 3 months — historically the deepest fallers tend to snap back. Ranked by how deep the fall is, with bonus credit for A-share-specific signs (a 2-week washout, a coiled volatility squeeze). Scored against the CSI 300 over the next 21 sessions, entering at the next day's price (T+1). Track record still accruing — display context, not a signal and not a buy list (CNPL-R1/R3/R4).同行业内近3个月跌幅最深的个股——历史上跌得最深的往往反弹也快。按跌幅深度排序，并对A股特有迹象（2周洗盘、波动压缩蓄势）加分。以次日价格入场（T+1）、未来21个交易日对沪深300的超额收益计分。成绩仍在累积——仅供展示参考，非信号、非买入清单（CNPL-R1/R3/R4）。
